name: oredeep
description: ORE DEEP — idle-добыча в гномьих чертогах (рескин баланса Idle Boxer)

scripts.build: mkdir -p www/tools www/js && cp index.html www/index.html && cp tools/ui_screens.js www/tools/ui_screens.js && cp js/*.js www/js/ && rm -rf www/art && cp -a art www/art
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.aab: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
